description: Update fields of an existing appointment in a given month.

all_day.description: Optional new all-day state for the appointment.

appointment_id.description: ID of the appointment to update.

attendees.description: Optional new attendees, as a list of names or identifiers.

end.description: Optional new end time, as a date/time string.

location.description: Optional new location for the appointment.

month.description: Month containing the appointment, as a number from 1 to 12.

notes.description: Optional new notes for the appointment.

notify.description: When true, notify attendees about the update.

occurrence_day.description: Optional day of the occurrence to update, for a repeating appointment.

reminders.description: Optional new reminders, as a list.

repeat.description: Optional new recurrence rule, as an object.

scope.description: Optional scope of the update for a repeating appointment, such as a single occurrence or the series.

start.description: Optional new start time, as a date/time string.

subject.description: Optional new subject (title) for the appointment.

year.description: Year of the month containing the appointment.

name: update_appointment
